law.binder: LAMBDA introduces exactly one nearest lexical binder for its body
law.reference: BOUND(n) denotes the n-th enclosing binder outward, with BOUND(0) the nearest binder
law.admission: BOUND(n) is valid iff 0 <= n < lexical_depth
law.root: a closed candidate is checked at lexical_depth=0
law.alpha_equivalence: bound-variable names are not semantic data; alpha-renaming cannot change the nameless term
law.capture: a closure captures the lexical environment present when LAMBDA is evaluated
law.application: applying a one-argument closure pushes the argument at lexical index 0 and shifts captured outer bindings outward
law.failure: a free or out-of-depth BOUND(n) fails closed
law.carrier: F3M-5 lambda ranking is a carrier experiment and does not itself allocate a canonical SENS domain identity
